target_customer: Indonesian teenagers and young families who want a savings and payments app
problem: Indonesian teens had no first party money app to learn saving and spending, and parents lacked a safe way to link accounts.
business_model: Consumer fintech app earning on deposits placed with partner banks and rural banks, and on payment activity, with no admin fees to users
product_category: Teen and family neobank savings and payments app

founders.name: Frederick Widjaja
prior_employers: Facebook (software engineer on Blood Donations and Messenger Rooms)
education: Harvard College, computer science and statistics

exit.reason: YC lists the company as Inactive, but whiz.id was live with a 2026 copyright and claimed more than 100,000 users.

technical_complexity.rationale: A money app needed e-money licensing via a Bank Indonesia payment service provider, QRIS payments and partner bank deposit integrations, mostly standard engineering with heavy regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: The Bank Indonesia payment license is a hurdle for rivals, but big wallets such as GoPay could target teens.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A profile names GoPay as a main competitor in digital payments; the profile is undated and no source shows GoPay acting against Whiz.

market_need_then: Whiz describes itself as Indonesia's first fintech for teenagers; no dated demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses whiz.id, a country domain; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Gen Z and family oriented savings copy with refer and earn campaigns

branding.community_and_virality: Site claims 100,000+ users, testimonials and a refer and earn campaign (company claim, unverified).

brand_strength.rationale: Short, friendly name and company claimed user numbers, but no independent brand coverage was found.

pivots.from: Teen money app for financial literacy
pivots.to: Family and Gen Z app with a Smart Saver high interest deposit product
pivots.why: The App Store description says Smart Saver was added in 2024 with a rural bank partner; reasons not stated

outcome_analysis: Whiz entered YC Winter 2022 with three founders and a teen focused money app in Jakarta. YC marks it Inactive, yet the product site was live in 2026 with a deposit product added in 2024, so the Inactive flag does not match the observed product. No shutdown or layoff news was found, so no failure cause is public.
notes: The $1M seed and investors Surge and Y Combinator come from CB Insights alone; DailySocial confirms Whiz joined Surge's seventh cohort but gives no amount or date. No dated competitor source found, so the list is empty. Legal entity is PT Midazpay Digital Indonesia.
